research_questions.question: SBOA调节SVMD紧致度是否降低分解复杂性并改善预测？
在相同IMF输入下TCN-BiLSTM是否优于单一预测器？
性能是否在季节及选定峰值时段保持？

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.core_logic: 从供需调度动机、统计/ML模型不足到时序连续性缺口，提出优化分解和时序混合预测两项贡献。
sections.input_commitment: 实际负荷非平稳且多周期
sections.output_commitment: 输出RQ1/RQ2；未把系统调度效果设为实测终点

sections.heading: Electricity Load Decomposition
sections.core_logic: 先定义SVMD约束，再说明SBOA搜索分解超参数。
sections.output_commitment: 输出可供逐IMF预测的分解

sections.heading: Successive Variational Mode Decomposition
sections.core_logic: 逐次提取模态并约束频带、残差信号及重构。

sections.heading: Secretary Bird Optimization Algorithm
sections.core_logic: 只将关键maxAlpha交给SBOA；其余参数采用经验值。

sections.heading: Initial Preparation Phase
sections.core_logic: 随机初始化位置、种群及适应度向量。

sections.heading: Hunting Strategy of Secretary Birds
sections.core_logic: 按迭代三阶段采用差分、Brownian、Levy更新及贪心选择。

sections.heading: Escape Strategy of Secretary Birds
sections.core_logic: 随机伪装/逃逸再选优直至终止。
sections.output_commitment: 输出best参数；仅算法规则非收敛证明

sections.heading: Short-Term Power Load Forecasting Model
sections.core_logic: 逐模块解释TCN、BiLSTM及串联关系。

sections.heading: TCN Neural Network Structure
sections.core_logic: 膨胀因果卷积扩大感受野，残差缓解优化困难。

sections.heading: BiLSTM Neural Network
sections.core_logic: 标准LSTM门控及双向序列编码。

sections.heading: Combined Prediction Model Based on TCN–BiLSTM
sections.core_logic: 1个残差块、2个卷积单元接BiLSTM与单神经元输出。
sections.output_commitment: 输出一步预测，日预测构造需与数据段联合理解

sections.heading: Combined Prediction Model Based on SVMD-SBOA-TCN-BiLSTM
sections.core_logic: SBOA选参数→SVMD→各IMF的TCN-BiLSTM→合成负荷。

sections.heading: Experimental Analysis
sections.core_logic: 数据、参数、分解、优化器和预测器比较，再查季节峰值。

sections.heading: Data Preparation
sections.core_logic: 说明全年15分钟数据、前10月训练后2月测试、异常插值和归一化。
sections.output_commitment: 输出训练测试协议；预处理拟合范围未明确

sections.heading: Parameter Settings and Evaluation Metrics
sections.core_logic: 报告网络/优化超参与MAE、RMSE、R²定义。

sections.heading: Power Load Sequence Decomposition
sections.core_logic: 6720点示例拆成4个IMF；三紧致度对照排列熵。
sections.input_commitment: 最优分解是否降低复杂度

sections.heading: Comparison of Different Optimization Algorithms
sections.core_logic: 以相同种群/迭代预算比较SBOA、SSA、GWO适应度。
sections.output_commitment: 输出图10；不足证明全局最优

sections.heading: Comparison of Different Sequence Decomposition Algorithms
sections.core_logic: CEEMDAN/ICEEMDAN替代分解，TCN-BiLSTM保持。

sections.heading: Comparison of Predictive Model Performance
sections.core_logic: 先去除整个分解块，再在共用IMF下比较ELM/LSTM/BiLSTM；报告分IMF运行时间。
sections.input_commitment: 模块必要性及预测器优劣

sections.heading: Comparison of Prediction Accuracy across Different Seasons
sections.core_logic: 各季独立5:1划分及选日、选峰时段误差。
sections.output_commitment: 输出表8–9及图14；不是跨地区外测

sections.heading: Discussion
sections.core_logic: 将结果联系电力调度并提出替换优化器和深度模型的未来方向。
sections.output_commitment: 工程收益仍需系统级实验

sections.heading: Conclusions
sections.core_logic: 总结优化分解及混合网络并重复误差改善。
sections.output_commitment: 误差优势有表6支持，全局最优论断超出图10证据
